posts.text:
The truth is all marketing now is just code and tokens.

So learning to market these days means learning to set up an agent with your data, creative tools and ad accounts.

Set it up right and you get a top 0.1% marketer testing an absurd number of ideas every day: https://t.co/64vZyolTFP https://t.co/pyXGW79Qrh
posts.text_zh:
真相是，现在所有营销都只是代码和 tokens。

所以现如今学习营销，意味着学会用你的数据、创意工具和广告账户来搭建一个 agent。

搭对了，你就相当于拥有一个顶尖 0.1% 的营销人，每天都能测试海量想法： https://t.co/64vZyolTFP https://t.co/pyXGW79Qrh

引用内容：他引用了自己稍早的帖子：learn to market is the new learn to code（学习营销就是新的学习编程）。

quoted.text_zh: 学习营销，就是新的学习编程。learn to market is the new learn to code https://t.co/2d8LTzHtzg

posts.text:
What's easier than trying to build a giant furniture library?

Letting users just upload their own furniture they want as a photo and then turn it into a 3d object in less than 30 seconds with an image-to-3d model ofcourse! https://t.co/n878FlRw7Z https://t.co/XDStwhZBuZ
posts.text_zh:
还有什么比试图建一个巨大的家具库更简单呢？

让用户把自己想要的家具拍成照片上传，然后用 image-to-3d 模型在不到 30 秒内把它变成 3D 物体，当然啦！ https://t.co/n878FlRw7Z https://t.co/XDStwhZBuZ

引用内容：他引用了自己稍早的进度更新：把整个 @IKEA 的 3D 目录导入了 Interior AI，现在可以导入户型图或漫游视频来重建房子并重新装修。

quoted.text:
✨ Progress update:

I imported the entire catalogue of @IKEA in 3d into Interior AI after seeing someone do the same yesterday, I'll try to import more furniture brands soon to get more variety too

Anyway so now you can import your home's blueprint or do a walk through video, it then rebuilds your home, and then you can redecorate it

This is now day 4 of rebuilding Interior AI now that's the models are smart enough to do 3d stuff properly, it still looks a bit clunky and all but it's going somewhere! 😊
quoted.text_zh:
✨ 进度更新：

看到有人昨天也这么做之后，我把整个 @IKEA 的 3D 目录导入了 Interior AI，之后还会再导入更多家具品牌，好增加多样性

总之，现在你可以导入家里的户型图，或者拍一段漫游视频，它就会重建你的家，然后你就可以重新装修了

现在是重建 Interior AI 的第 4 天，因为模型已经足够聪明，能把 3D 的事情做像样了，看起来还是有点笨拙，但已经在往前走了！😊

🍿 https://t.co/nKrqXP5ZWD

引用内容：他引用了 @JoannaStern 的帖子：Apple 今年在 Siri AI 上取得了不小进展，但 Siri 在基础功能上仍然吃力，在新的 HomeView 上尤为明显。这段评测切片概括了问题所在。

quoted.text: Apple made big strides with Siri AI this year, but Siri still struggles with the basics. And nowhere is that more obvious than on the new HomeView. This clip from my review sums up the problem. https://t.co/E16R4MZlJm

Noo I asked Claude what to use 100% free and it said OBS with a circle mask on the webcam

It even made the circle mask for me 😃 https://t.co/8oP3w7ttK8 https://t.co/Fqnuo4m81r
posts.text_zh:
没有啦，我问了 Claude 有什么 100% 免费的方案，它说用 OBS，再给网络摄像头加一个圆形蒙版

它甚至还帮我把圆形蒙版做出来了 😃 https://t.co/8oP3w7ttK8 https://t.co/Fqnuo4m81r

引用内容：他引用了 @Thosch_io 的回复：问是不是用 Loom 录的，想给自己在做的东西也做出这样的演示；并希望旋转家具时点一次就能一直转，选项保持可见直到点掉为止。

quoted.text:
Is it loom you used to record? I want to make stone demos like this for some stuff I’m working on.

And please make it so you don’t have to click on furniture then rotate then click on furniture then rotate. Should be just click furniture then rotate as much as you want (have the options stay viddi le until clicked off)
quoted.text_zh:
是用 Loom 录的吗？我想给自己在做的一些东西也做出这样的演示。

另外，希望旋转家具时不要点一下转一下、再点一下再转一下。应该是点一下家具后就能一直转（选项保持可见，直到点掉为止）。
